verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.178
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.178

verses.pali: 18. Sañcetaniyavagga
verses.english: 18. Intention

verses.pali: Jambālīsutta
verses.english: Billabong

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: Take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on the cessation of substantial reality,

verses.pali: Tassa sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṁ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
verses.english: but on that their mind does not leap forth, gain confidence, settle down, and become decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You wouldn’t expect that mendicant to realize the cessation of substantial reality.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso lepagatena hatthena sākhaṁ gaṇheyya, tassa so hattho sajjeyyapi gaṇheyyapi bajjheyyapi;
verses.english: Suppose a person were to grab a branch with a glue-smeared hand. Their hand would stick, hold, and bind to it.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: In the same way, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on the cessation of substantial reality,

verses.pali: Tassa sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṁ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
verses.english: but on that their mind does not leap forth, gain confidence, settle down, and become decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno na sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You wouldn’t expect that mendicant to realize the cessation of substantial reality.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: Next, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on the cessation of substantial reality,

verses.pali: Tassa sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṁ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
verses.english: and on that their mind leaps forth, gains confidence, settles down, and becomes decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You would expect that mendicant to realize the cessation of substantial reality.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso suddhena hatthena sākhaṁ gaṇheyya, tassa so hattho neva sajjeyya na gaṇheyya na bajjheyya;
verses.english: Suppose a person were to grab a branch with a clean hand. Their hand wouldn’t stick, hold, or bind to it.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: In the same way, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on the cessation of substantial reality,

verses.pali: Tassa sakkāyanirodhaṁ manasi karoto sakkāyanirodhe cittaṁ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
verses.english: and on that their mind leaps forth, gains confidence, settles down, and becomes decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sakkāyanirodho pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You would expect that mendicant to realize the cessation of substantial reality.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: Next, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on smashing ignorance,

verses.pali: Tassa avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṁ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
verses.english: but on that their mind does not leap forth, gain confidence, settle down, and become decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You wouldn’t expect that mendicant to smash ignorance.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, jambālī anekavassagaṇikā.
verses.english: Suppose there was a billabong that had been stagnant for many years.

verses.pali: Tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, devo ca na sammā dhāraṁ anuppaveccheyya.
verses.english: And someone was to close off the inlets and open up the drains, and the heavens didn’t provide enough rain.

verses.pali: Evañhi tassā, bhikkhave, jambāliyā na āḷippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You wouldn’t expect that billabong to break its banks.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: In the same way, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a certain peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on smashing ignorance,

verses.pali: Tassa avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṁ na pakkhandati nappasīdati na santiṭṭhati nādhimuccati.
verses.english: but on that their mind does not leap forth, gain confidence, settle down, and become decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno na avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You wouldn’t expect that mendicant to smash ignorance.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: Next, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on smashing ignorance,

verses.pali: Tassa avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṁ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
verses.english: and on that their mind leaps forth, gains confidence, settles down, and becomes decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You would expect that mendicant to smash ignorance.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, jambālī anekavassagaṇikā.
verses.english: Suppose there was a billabong that had been stagnant for many years.

verses.pali: Tassā puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya, yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya, devo ca sammā dhāraṁ anuppaveccheyya.
verses.english: And someone was to open up the inlets and close off the drains, and the heavens provided plenty of rain.

verses.pali: Evañhi tassā, bhikkhave, jambāliyā āḷippabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You would expect that billabong to break its banks.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṁ santaṁ cetovimuttiṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: In the same way, take a mendicant who enters and remains in a certain peaceful release of the heart.

verses.pali: So avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoti.
verses.english: They focus on smashing ignorance,

verses.pali: Tassa avijjāppabhedaṁ manasi karoto avijjāppabhede cittaṁ pakkhandati pasīdati santiṭṭhati adhimuccati.
verses.english: and on that their mind leaps forth, gains confidence, settles down, and becomes decided.

verses.pali: Tassa kho evaṁ, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno avijjāppabhedo pāṭikaṅkho.
verses.english: You would expect that mendicant to smash ignorance.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
